answer.worked:
The card has side length $\sqrt{49}=7\text{ cm}$. Cutting $1\text{ cm}$ from each end leaves base dimensions $7-2=5\text{ cm}$ by $5\text{ cm}$. The box height is $1\text{ cm}$.

$V=5\times5\times1=25\text{ cm}^3$.
